ABOUT CITY BOY MOVEMENT

About CBM Ogun

City Boy Movement Ogun is the Ogun State chapter of the City Boy Movement, a youth-led network standing firmly behind President Bola Ahmed Tinubu, GCFR, and the Renewed Hope Agenda. From Abeokuta to Ijebu-Ode, Sagamu to Ota, we bring young people together to understand the President’s programmes, share the progress being made, and rally support for progressive governance under the APC.

We believe Ogun’s young people have the energy, ideas and voice to shape the future of our state and our nation, and we’re here to help them use it.

Our Vision

An Ogun State where every young person is informed, engaged and empowered: driving the growth of our towns and cities, strengthening democracy at the grassroots, and championing the Renewed Hope Agenda.

Our Mission

To organise young people across all 20 local government areas of Ogun State into a strong, active network that promotes the President’s policies, builds civic awareness, encourages voter participation, and connects youths to opportunities in enterprise and digital skills.

All resources & FAQs
How do I join the movement?
Use any “Join the Movement” button on this website. It opens the national registration page in a new tab. Membership is handled on that platform.
Can I register on this website?
Individual membership registration takes place on the national CBM website. Support groups can use the support group registration section on this page.
Where will Ogun chapter events be announced?
Visit News & Events for chapter information and links to national announcements.
